Crate labels, explained for returning guests
They often ask us about it

Crate labels for returning guests

When you travel with a crate that has already been accepted on a prior trip, the label helps our team match the kennel to the right booking and handling notes. Keep the label clean, readable, and fixed to the outside where staff can see it without moving the animal's crate.

Use the label to show the traveler's name, the animal's name if you use one, and any current care notes that still apply. If a label is loose, faded, or covered by tape, replace it before check-in. A clear label reduces delays and helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk confirm the crate quickly.

If your animal needs special handling, place that note on the label and also tell the counter team at arrival. Do not rely on old labels from a previous trip, since care needs can change between journeys. When a crate is reused, check that the label matches the present booking and that nothing has been left on it from an earlier trip. <<FACT F028>> Keep the crate secure and easy to inspect so the animal can move through the process with less stress.

For guests traveling through Caldreth, also make sure the pet relief area instructions are current before you reach the gate. <<FACT F013>> If anything on the label seems unclear, the staff will review it with you at the desk.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before travel or speak with the counter team at check-in.
